transcript.answer: Conversations started surviving an api restart on 2026-09-30. That is when issue #296 ('Persist support conversations through HAL Engine's MongoSessionStore') was opened and closed, within about an hour. The api previously called `createHalEngine` without a session store, so the in-memory default lost every conversation on restart. #296 composed HAL Engine's `MongoSessionStore` into `apps/api`, and the README now says conversations survive a restart. I inferred the date from the issue's close time. I did not find the merge PR itself. Earlier issue #23 (closed 2026-09-23) covered the groundwork. Retention sweeps, GDPR erasure and reconnect resume were left out of #296 and handled separately.
